$comment: SOURCE-REVIEW CANDIDATES ONLY. No owner approval, default, numeric limit, runtime configuration support or deployment is asserted. Do not activate without provider review and actual runtime checks.

allow_hx.title: Allow heat exchangers
allow_hx.description: Candidate flag passed by GenerateTopology to enumerate_networks(allow_hx=...). Node owner must confirm meaning and default.

allow_bypass.title: Allow bypasses
allow_bypass.description: Candidate flag passed by GenerateTopology to enumerate_networks(allow_bypass=...). Defaults differ between the configuration assistant and topology handler; owner decision is required.

how_many.title: Maximum topology results
how_many.description: Candidate run_config value passed to enumerate_networks(max_results=...). The existing handler uses a fallback for falsy values. Owner must confirm semantics, default and valid limits.
